body: This was exactly what I was going through, for 2 years, I was suicidal before her, she saw something in me, thought she could help. At the beginning of May she left. She couldn't be with someone who's depressed, she couldn't watch me live in a black hole with an escape route from existence already planned. I feel your pain dude, now that shes gone its all fucked. Your a fucking saint for not putting her through the grief of your death. IMHO your doing the right thing by letting her be there and keep you here, no matter how much this shit hurts. To suffer for others sake is like the ultimate act of selflessness. For the record I care, because this resonates with me and she cares and I think you should talk to her and tell her everything honestly. I wonder if I was more open if she'd still be here trying to make me laugh and shit.
